2fa.title: Set Up 2FA
2fa.step1Desc: Download Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator on your phone.
2fa.step2Desc: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code below.
2fa.step3Desc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
2fa.disableConfirm: Are you sure you want to disable two-factor authentication (2FA)? Your account security will be reduced.
